biography:
I am a seasoned and versatile leader in the real estate and construction industry, with over twelve years of experience in diverse roles and sectors. As the former Chief Operating Officer of Reston Construction and Reston Equity Group, I led and oversaw the strategic, operational, and financial aspects of two dynamic and innovative companies that specialize in multifamily, residential, commercial, urban planning, and master planning projects.

My core competencies include corporate strategy, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, construction management, construction estimating, and design. I have a Master of Business Administration degree in Real Estate Development from the University of Denver, and a Bachelor of Applied Science degree in Architectural Engineering from the University of Colorado Boulder. I also have certifications in Fundamentals of Engineering (F.E.), and OSHA. I am passionate about creating and executing innovative solutions that enhance the built environment and drive sustainable growth. I have successfully performed strategic corporate re-alignments for multiple VCs, supported M&A transactions for firms, standardized processes and procedures, provided preconstruction management services, and developed real estate proformas and holistic project approaches. I am also skilled in green engineering and analytical techniques, which enable me to optimize the environmental and economic performance of projects.
